description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Cincinnati Tri-State (OH-KY-IN) market (PTF-CINCINNATI-RELEASE-CONTRACT-001). Every number below is derived from this market's own committed authority via scripts.pettripfinder.release_contracts.derive_authority, not hard-coded from memory. It describes only this market's reviewed authority and grants no deployment authorization.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is structurally deployable: its authority files agree, its routes match its reviewed inventory, no held identity leaks, and every publish/tech gate holds. It is not a deployment authorization and it makes no claim that the market's identity universe is fully resolved -- 223 of this market's 256 confirmed identities are still unresolved. PTF-CINCINNATI-21C-FOUNDER-DECISION-APPLICATION-001 resolved 21c Museum Hotel Cincinnati (APPROVE_PARTIAL_PUBLICATION, pets_allowed only) after PTF-CINCINNATI-21C-RECAPTURE-001 supplied the artifact hash the original pass was missing. Cincinnati's Fidelity Hotel (pre-opening hold) remains untouched, and this contract makes no claim about it.

identity_census.note: The committed census is the Cincinnati Tri-State identity universe (OH/KY/IN). Policy publication is restricted to the 21 founder-approved PUBLICATION_CANDIDATE facts (20 from PTF-CINCINNATI-CAPTURE-PASS1-FOUNDER-DECISIONS plus 21c Museum Hotel Cincinnati from PTF-CINCINNATI-21C-FOUNDER-DECISION-APPLICATION-001) and 6 founder-approved VERIFIED_NO_PETS exclusions; 17 identity holds, 13 routing-unresolved identities, and 193 identities still awaiting policy observation remain unresolved. 6 identities are ruled out of the current lodging category (short-term rentals and guesthouses the source directories list beside hotels).

reconciliation.note: Counts are derived from the committed policy package and exclusion registry via derive_authority(), the same machinery every other market's contract uses; unresolved is not negative pet evidence. 'resolved' counts published + verified-no-pets + the 6 OUT_OF_CURRENT_CATEGORY exclusion-registry records this market owns (PTF-CINCINNATI-CATEGORY-EXIT-REGISTRY-REPAIR-001 mechanically registered these -- a disposition already made by PTF-CINCINNATI-CENSUS-RECONCILIATION-001, not a new decision -- matching the representation Columbus and Pittsburgh already use for the same disposition class). 256 = 21 + 6 + 6 + 223.

policy_package.note: The live Cincinnati policy package is the sole identity authority for its twenty-one verified profiles; no hard-coded allow-list is repeated here. The first twenty were written by PTF-CINCINNATI-PASS1-AUTHORITY-APPLICATION-001 from the founder's 26 ready Capture Pass 1 decisions; the 21st (21c Museum Hotel Cincinnati) was added by PTF-CINCINNATI-21C-FOUNDER-DECISION-APPLICATION-001 once its artifact hash was recaptured.
policy_package.schema_note: Schema 1.2; each record retains its founder decision binding and final record/evidence hashes.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: Every other unresolved or category-excluded census identity has no seed row and no public route. This market currently holds none -- every seed row it owns is published.

routes.note: route_mode market_prefixed: this market's hub, corridor, and policy-comparison pages live under /pet-friendly-hotels/cincinnati-oh/. 6 of this market's 22 configured corridors are above their publication minimum and claim a route, derived from the twenty-one published hotels' own corridor assignments; the market is registered assemblable but not yet enabled in primary navigation (show_in_navigation is a separate, unrelated market-config setting).

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.
